description: Start here. Without an integration, explains the ways to add Trickl (own business such as a SaaS, or a multi-seller platform) and how to choose. With one, returns a step-by-step plan for the coding agent: keys, exact API calls, webhook handling, what to store, and how to prove it works with this server's sandbox tools.

integration.description: own_*: the user's own business gets paid (SaaS, app, course, membership); own_embedded_checkout puts checkout inside their app. platform_*: many sellers on the user's platform get paid. embedded = in-page iframe, hosted = redirect to Trickl. embed_widget: paste-in pricing widget, no backend. Omit to see the choices.

name: get_started
title: Get a Trickl setup plan
